title: Qwen3.8-27B INT6 mixed AutoRound on dual RTX 3090: vLLM 0.28 TP=2 + MTP, BF16 KV
slug_note: Author-reported ~101 tok/s narrative and ~138 tok/s code decode on two power-limited 3090s, with a 278K-token BF16 KV pool.

engine.config: vLLM 0.28.0 + the small mixed-quant patch from the club-3090 quants repo; TP=2, PP=1, BF16 KV cache (278,335-token pool), FlashInfer attention, MTP n=4, chunked prefill, prefix caching

requirements.notes: Post does not state VRAM use. Run on 2x 24 GB with 0.95 GPU memory utilisation. Not verified for any other card count.

steps.text: Install vLLM 0.28.0 and apply the mixed-quant patch from the club-3090 quants repo (the post says it is needed; the post does not link the patch)

vllm serve <local path to Minachist/Qwen3.8-27B-INT6-Mixed-AutoRound> --tensor-parallel-size 2 --pipeline-parallel-size 1 --max-model-len 262144 --max-num-seqs 2 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.95 --kv-cache-dtype bfloat16 --attention-backend FLASHINFER --enable-prefix-caching --mamba-cache-mode align --enable-chunked-prefill --long-prefill-token-threshold 2048 --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":4,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic"}' --reasoning-parser qwen3 --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder --enable-auto-tool-choice

measurements.method: club-3090 `report.sh --bench`, temp 0.6 top_p 0.95 top_k 20, single stream (per post)
measurements.note: narrative run 1 of 5; the five runs range 94.48 to 101.02 tok/s

measurements.note: code run 1 of 5; the five runs range 130.37 to 138.12 tok/s

caveats: Power-limited to 250 W per card, PCIe Gen4 x8/x8, no NVLink, p2p-patched; video output on GPU1 (author says ~3% utilisation headroom).
Author ran vLLM with auth enabled and had to adjust the bench harness; says it should not have affected results.
The post does not test long-context behaviour, which the author says is where the BF16 KV cache should help.
Needs a patched vLLM; stock vLLM is not stated to load this mixed quant.
